content2.content: The `firebase_core` package is required to use any Firebase service in Flutter. It handles the initialization of the Firebase SDK.

content7.content: You must initialize Firebase before using any other Firebase plugins. This is usually done in the `main` function.

content10.content: Initializing `firebase_core` with the options generated by `flutterfire configure` ensures your app connects to the correct Firebase project on all platforms.
